# Historical compatibility fixtures

These fixtures were generated by the retired Go server and are retained as
independent compatibility evidence for the Rust engine, account handling,
random-number generation, sessions, and shared TypeScript rules. They are data,
not another server implementation.

The `compatibility/` scenarios preserve exact action and recipient-view
behavior, including explicitly normalized nondeterministic fields. Do not
regenerate golden results from the implementation being tested merely to make
tests pass. When intentional behavior changes require a fixture update, explain
the semantic difference and retain focused regression coverage.
